description: Web UI for github-trendings CLI — discover rising GitHub repos with star velocity scoring

stories.label: Project Setup — Next.js + Tailwind + Dependencies
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 project created with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
Package.json contains: next, react, react-dom, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, lucide-react, axios
tailwind.config.ts exists with content paths configured

stories.label: Layout Component — Header + Footer
acceptanceCriteria: Header has GitHub star count link to the repo
Footer with MIT license and credits
Layout wraps all pages via app/layout.tsx

stories.label: Home Page — Search + Filter UI
acceptanceCriteria: Page at app/page.tsx renders search form
Language input field with placeholder 'e.g. TypeScript, Python, Go...'

stories.label: Results Display — Repo Cards + Table
acceptanceCriteria: Repo results displayed as cards in a grid (1-3 columns responsive)
Each card shows: rank, name (link), description (truncated), stars, velocity, language, age
Cards show burst indicator for young high-velocity repos
Empty state message when no results
Error state shown if API call fails
Results persist in URL params for shareability

stories.label: API Route — /api/discover
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts GET params: window, lang, limit
Calls GitHub Search API with proper headers
Returns JSON array of scored repos

stories.label: Responsive Design + Dark Mode
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode support via Tailwind dark: classes

stories.label: Vercel Deployment
acceptanceCriteria: Deployed URL is accessible and returns the home page
